name: baystate-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Bay State Pet and Garden Supply - Next.js web app and Python scraper

scripts.bootstrap: bun install && bun run web:db:start && bun run web:bootstrap && bun run scraper:sync-env
scripts.dev:up: bun run bootstrap && bunx concurrently -k -n web,stripe,scraper "bun run web:dev" "bun run stripe:listen" "bun run scraper:up && docker logs -f baystate-scraper-dev"
scripts.prod:up: bun run bootstrap && bun --cwd apps/web x vercel env pull .env.local --environment=production --yes && bunx concurrently -k -n web,stripe,scraper "bun run web:dev" "bun run stripe:listen" "bun run scraper:up && docker logs -f baystate-scraper-dev"
scripts.down: bun run web:db:stop && docker rm -f baystate-stripe-dev 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -p baystate-dev -f apps/scraper/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.check: bunx turbo run lint typecheck test
scripts.stripe:setup: bun run stripe:login && bun run stripe:listen
